incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are spraying water at a house engulfed in flames and thick smoke, with a grassy slope in the foreground.

observations.description: Large plume of thick, dark smoke rising from the burning structure.
Bright orange flames visible through windows and roof openings of the house.
Signs of fire damage to the house, including charred wood and broken sections of the roof and walls.
At least three firefighters in gear, positioned on a grassy slope operating a hose.
Trees and green grass covering a sloped area in front of the house.
Utility pole visible in the background, with wires stretching across the scene.
